name: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and Keras
certifications: No vendor certification since the TensorFlow Developer Certificate closed; assessed by capstone project
Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer as a companion certification

beginner.summary: For Python developers and data scientists starting deep learning with TensorFlow. Covers set-up and GPUs, tensors, GradientTape, Keras Sequential and Functional models, compiling and training, tf.data, CNNs, augmentation layers, transfer learning, text preprocessing and classification, LSTMs and GRUs, callbacks and TensorBoard, regularisation, saving in the Keras format, custom layers, GPUs and TPUs, evaluation and deploying a model as a REST service.
prerequisites: Writes Python with functions, classes and NumPy
outcomes: Build and train neural networks with Keras
Prepare data with tf.data and preprocessing layers
Train image and text models with transfer learning
Evaluate, save and deploy TensorFlow models

subtopics: TensorFlow compared with PyTorch and JAX
The TensorFlow ecosystem: tf.data, TensorBoard, Serving and LiteRT
The course project: a product image classifier
days.lab_task: Install TensorFlow locally and open Colab, confirm GPU access, train a tiny Keras model on CPU and GPU, compare speed and pin the environment.
checks: Same model trained on CPU and GPU with timings

days.lab_task: Solve fifteen tensor exercises covering creation, reshaping, broadcasting and variables, and fix five planted shape errors.
checks: All fifteen outputs match expected tensors

subtopics: A linear model trained by hand
days.lab_task: Compute gradients with GradientTape, train a linear regression model by hand with gradient descent and compare learning rates.
checks: Loss falls steadily during manual training
Effect of three learning rates explained

days.lab_task: Build Sequential models for classification and regression, read their summaries, check parameter counts by hand and run predictions before training.
checks: Both models produce outputs of the right shape
Cases that need the Functional API listed
objectives: Know when to use other APIs

days.lab_task: Build a product model that takes an image and tabular features and predicts category and price, with a shared layer and a residual block, and plot it.
checks: Model accepts two inputs and returns two outputs
Shared layer weights used in two branches

days.topic: Compiling and Training: Losses, Optimisers and Metrics
days.lab_task: Train the product model with suitable losses and metrics per output, compare optimisers and plot training and validation curves.
checks: Loss weights balance the two outputs

subtopics: Datasets from tensors, files and directories
days.lab_task: Build a tf.data pipeline that reads product images from folders, decodes, resizes, shuffles, batches, caches and prefetches them, and measure its speed.
checks: Batches have the expected shapes and labels
Prefetch and parallel calls raise throughput
Data written to and read from TFRecord files

days.lab_task: Build and train a CNN on the product images, add batch normalisation, visualise feature maps and compare with a dense network.
checks: CNN accuracy higher than the dense network
Training more stable with batch normalisation
Feature maps plotted for sample images

days.lab_task: Add augmentation layers inside the model and in the tf.data pipeline, view augmented samples and measure the effect on validation accuracy.
Fine-tune a pretrained EfficientNet on the product images with feature extraction then fine-tuning, and compare with the CNN trained from scratch.
checks: Frozen base with a new head trains quickly
Transfer learning beats the scratch CNN

days.lab_task: Build a review sentiment classifier with TextVectorization and embeddings, then fine-tune a pretrained KerasHub encoder and compare results.
checks: Embedding model beats the majority-class baseline
Pretrained encoder beats the baseline model
Vocabulary and lengths chosen and justified

days.topic: Sequence Models with LSTMs and GRUs
days.lab_task: Classify sensor sequences with LSTM and GRU models, mask padding, try bidirectional layers and compare accuracy and speed.
checks: Padded steps ignored by the model
LSTM, GRU and bidirectional results compared

days.topic: Callbacks: Early Stopping, Checkpoints and TensorBoard
days.lab_task: Add early stopping, best-model checkpoints, learning rate reduction and TensorBoard logging to training, write a custom callback and compare three runs in TensorBoard.
days.deliverable: Training with callbacks and TensorBoard logs
checks: Training stops at the best validation epoch

days.lab_task: Overfit a model on a small dataset, then fix it with dropout, L2 regularisation, augmentation and early stopping, comparing validation curves.

days.topic: Saving and Loading Models in the Keras Format
days.lab_task: Save the classifier in the .keras format, reload it with a custom layer, export a SavedModel for serving and check predictions match after each step.
checks: Model with a custom layer reloads correctly

days.lab_task: Write a custom attention-pooling layer, a custom metric and a model with its own train_step, test them and save and reload the model.
checks: Layer works inside a Functional model
Custom step trains the model correctly
Unit tests pass for the layer and metric

days.lab_task: Train with mixed precision on a GPU, run the same model on a Colab TPU with a distribution strategy and compare speed and accuracy.
Evaluate the classifier with per-class metrics and a confusion matrix, explain predictions with Grad-CAM and write an evaluation report.
checks: Precision and recall shown per class
Grad-CAM highlights the relevant image regions

days.topic: Deploying a Model as a REST Service
days.lab_task: Serve the exported classifier with TensorFlow Serving in Docker, call it over REST, roll out a second model version and measure latency.
Build a product image classifier with a tf.data pipeline, augmentation, transfer learning, callbacks, evaluation with Grad-CAM and a served REST endpoint, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation report and running service
checks: Test accuracy meets the agreed target
REST service returns predictions for new images
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For practitioners who already train models with Keras. Covers custom training loops, advanced tf.data, Keras 3 multi-backend models, attention and transformers, KerasHub fine-tuning, detection and segmentation, tf.distribute, mixed precision and XLA, KerasTuner, TFX pipelines, model analysis and fairness, TensorFlow Serving in production, LiteRT, TensorFlow.js, forecasting, recommenders, generative models, profiling and testing.
prerequisites: Has trained CNNs or text models with Keras
outcomes: Write flexible, scalable TensorFlow training code
Build production pipelines with TFX and serving
Deploy models to mobile, browser and servers

days.lab_task: Write a custom training loop with tf.function, metrics, gradient accumulation and TensorBoard logging, and check it matches model.fit results.
checks: Custom loop results close to model.fit
Larger effective batch without more memory

subtopics: Handling large text and image corpora
days.lab_task: Rebuild the input pipeline for a large sharded dataset with interleave, autotune and snapshots, profile it and remove the input bottleneck.
checks: GPU no longer waits for input

subtopics: Using Keras models in PyTorch or JAX training
days.lab_task: Write a model with keras.ops only, train it on the TensorFlow, JAX and PyTorch backends, compare speed and save and reload it across backends.
checks: Same code trains on all three
Model saved on one backend loads on another

days.lab_task: Build a transformer encoder for text classification with MultiHeadAttention, masks and positional embeddings, then train a small vision transformer.
checks: Small ViT trains on product images

days.lab_task: Fine-tune a KerasHub text backbone for support ticket routing and a small generative model with LoRA, evaluate both and write model cards.
checks: Generative model adapts to the domain style

days.topic: Object Detection and Segmentation with Keras
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a pretrained detector on shelf images, compute mAP, train a segmentation model for product masks and visualise predictions.
checks: Masks match products on test images

subtopics: Scaling batch size and learning rate
days.lab_task: Train the classifier with MirroredStrategy on several GPUs and with TPUStrategy, scale batch size and learning rate and compare speed and accuracy.
Train with mixed precision and XLA separately and together, compare speed, memory and accuracy, and explain any slowdowns.
checks: Mixed precision run stable and faster

days.lab_task: Tune layer sizes, dropout and learning rate with Hyperband and Bayesian search, compare with the hand-tuned model and confirm on a test set.
checks: Best trial beats the hand-tuned model
Gain holds on the test set

subtopics: TFX components: ExampleGen, StatisticsGen, SchemaGen, Transform, Trainer, Evaluator and Pusher
days.lab_task: Build a TFX pipeline for the product classifier from data ingestion to model push, run it locally and inspect artefacts and metadata.
checks: Artefact lineage shown in ML Metadata
Model pushed only when it beats the baseline

days.lab_task: Evaluate a loan approval model across slices with Model Analysis and Fairness Indicators, find a disparity, try a mitigation and document the result.
checks: Mitigation reduces the gap with trade-offs stated

days.lab_task: Run TensorFlow Serving on Kubernetes with batching, two model versions, a canary rollout, Prometheus metrics and a load test.
checks: New version gets a share of traffic

days.topic: LiteRT for Mobile and Edge Devices
subtopics: LiteRT, the successor to TensorFlow Lite
days.lab_task: Convert the classifier to LiteRT, quantise it, run it in a sample Android app with a GPU delegate and measure latency, size and accuracy.
checks: LiteRT model runs on the device
Latency lower with the GPU delegate

days.lab_task: Convert the classifier to TensorFlow.js, run it in a web page on webcam images with the WebGPU or WebGL backend and measure frames per second.
checks: No images sent to a server

days.lab_task: Build windowed datasets for store demand, compare dense, CNN and LSTM forecasters against a seasonal baseline with backtesting and produce prediction intervals.
checks: Best model beats the seasonal baseline

days.lab_task: Build a two-tower retrieval model and a ranking model for products, evaluate with top-k metrics and serve fast retrieval with approximate nearest neighbours.
checks: Ranking model improves on retrieval order

days.topic: Generative Models: Autoencoders, GANs and Diffusion in Keras
days.lab_task: Train a VAE and a small GAN on product images, generate images with a pretrained diffusion model and use the autoencoder for anomaly detection.
checks: Pretrained model creates images from prompts

days.lab_task: Profile a slow training run, find input and operator bottlenecks, fix them and show shorter epochs and higher device use.

days.topic: Testing and Reproducibility for TensorFlow Code
days.lab_task: Add unit tests for layers, pipelines and a small training run, make runs deterministic, version data and models and run the tests in CI.
checks: Same seed and config give the same metrics
Data and model versions tied to runs

days.lab_task: Build a TFX pipeline with validation, tuning, fairness-aware evaluation and pushing to TensorFlow Serving, plus a LiteRT export for mobile, then report results.
checks: Pipeline trains, evaluates and pushes the model
Model served on the server and running on a phone
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one pipeline
Deliver models to servers and devices

advanced.summary: For senior ML engineers and platform teams using TensorFlow. Covers graph internals and AutoGraph, custom ops and XLA, large-scale distributed training on TPUs and GPUs, the Model Optimization Toolkit, JAX interoperability, large language models in Keras, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, serving at scale, TFX with Vertex AI, federated learning, privacy-preserving ML, on-device ML at scale, explainability, data validation and drift, migrating TensorFlow 1 code, choosing frameworks, input pipeline engineering, production debugging and platform leadership.
prerequisites: Several years building models with TensorFlow and Keras
Strong Python and ML engineering skills
outcomes: Engineer large-scale TensorFlow training and serving
Build private, fair and explainable ML systems
Run production ML platforms on TFX and Vertex AI

days.topic: TensorFlow Internals: Graphs, tf.function and AutoGraph
days.lab_task: Trace functions with different inputs to show retracing, fix it with input signatures, inspect concrete functions and explain an AutoGraph conversion.
checks: Python control flow converted as described

subtopics: Writing ops in Python with tf.numpy_function and limits
days.lab_task: Implement a fused operation with XLA, add a custom gradient for numerical stability, benchmark it and debug a compilation failure.
checks: Gradient stable where the default failed
XLA version faster than the unfused version

days.topic: Large-Scale Distributed Training on TPUs and GPUs
days.lab_task: Run a multi-worker training job on cloud GPUs or TPUs with sharded input, preemption-safe checkpoints and monitoring, and estimate cost per run.
checks: Training resumes after a worker is preempted

days.topic: Model Optimization Toolkit: Quantisation, Pruning and Clustering
days.lab_task: Apply quantisation-aware training, pruning and clustering to the classifier, combine them and compare size, latency and accuracy on server and phone.
checks: QAT model keeps accuracy after quantisation
Pruned model smaller with acceptable accuracy
Latency compared on server and phone

days.topic: JAX Interoperability and Keras 3 Backends at Scale
subtopics: Why teams mix TensorFlow and JAX
Keras 3 on JAX for large training
JAX transformations: jit, grad and vmap
Choosing a backend for a project
days.lab_task: Train the same Keras model on the JAX and TensorFlow backends at larger scale, use jit and vmap in a custom step, and compare throughput and tooling.
checks: Model trains with the JAX backend at scale
Custom step uses jit and vmap correctly

days.topic: Large Language Models with Keras and KerasHub
days.lab_task: Load a language model preset, fine-tune it on support conversations, compare sampling settings, evaluate outputs and add a simple safety filter.
checks: Fine-tuned model follows the domain style
objectives: Work with language models in Keras

days.lab_task: Fine-tune a language model with LoRA at three ranks, compare quality, memory and speed, merge the best adapter and manage adapters for two customers.
checks: Quality and memory compared across ranks

days.topic: Serving at Scale: Batching, Versioning and Canary Releases
days.lab_task: Tune batching and warm-up for a high-traffic endpoint, run shadow and canary releases, autoscale on load and report cost per thousand predictions.
checks: Throughput higher at the same latency
New model receives mirrored traffic without user impact

days.topic: Production ML Pipelines with TFX and Vertex AI
days.lab_task: Run the TFX pipeline on Vertex AI with scheduled retraining, model registry, an approval step and deployment to an endpoint with monitoring.
checks: Pipeline retrains and registers a new model

days.lab_task: Simulate federated training across 50 clients with uneven data, compare with central training and measure communication rounds and accuracy.
Train a model with DP-SGD at two privacy budgets, run a membership inference test against private and non-private models and document the trade-offs.
checks: Private models trained at two budgets
Attack success lower for private models

days.topic: On-Device ML at Scale with LiteRT
subtopics: Model updates through app releases or downloads
tools: Firebase ML or a model delivery service
days.lab_task: Plan delivery of a model to a varied Android fleet, test delegates and fallbacks on three devices, download model updates at runtime and collect on-device metrics.
days.deliverable: On-device delivery plan and test results
checks: Model works on three different devices with fallbacks
New model downloaded without an app release

days.lab_task: Explain image, text and tabular model predictions with Grad-CAM, integrated gradients and SHAP, check whether explanations are stable and present them to a business audience.

days.topic: Data Validation and Drift Monitoring with TFDV
days.lab_task: Build schemas and statistics for training data, detect anomalies and skew in serving data, alert on drift and trigger retraining.
checks: Bad serving batch flagged against the schema
Drift alert starts the retraining pipeline

days.lab_task: Migrate a TensorFlow 1 Estimator model to Keras, convert its checkpoints, prove output parity and plan the migration of the remaining models.
checks: Remaining models ranked by effort and risk

days.topic: Choosing Between TensorFlow, PyTorch and JAX
days.lab_task: Build the same small model in all three frameworks, compare developer experience, performance and production tooling, and write a framework recommendation.
checks: Same model works in all three

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Training Input Pipelines
subtopics: The tf.data service for disaggregated input
days.lab_task: Make a large training job input-bound on purpose, move preprocessing to a tf.data service fleet, tune storage formats and caching and restore full accelerator use.
checks: Profiler shows accelerators waiting on input

days.lab_task: Work through four model incidents: a skewed feature, a latency regression, a wrong model version and slow accuracy decay, fix each and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Design an internal deep learning platform for five teams with templates, compute quotas, model governance and value metrics, and present a roadmap.
checks: Approval steps defined for production models

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Production Recommender on TFX and Vertex AI
days.lab_task: Build a production recommender with a TFX pipeline on Vertex AI, two-tower retrieval and ranking, data validation, privacy review, serving at scale and drift monitoring, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, deployed system, reports and defence
checks: Offline metrics meet targets and beat the baseline
Serving meets latency and cost targets
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one system
